newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-CANTONA IS FRENCH PEOPLE'S CHOICE FOR WORLD CUP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CANTONA IS FRENCH PEOPLE'S CHOICE FOR WORLD CUP.

text.p: Manchester United's Eric Cantona, out of the French national team for over two years, is the people's choice to play for the hosts of the 1998 World Cup, according to a new survey.

In a poll published by Sunday newspaper Le Journal du Dimanche, Cantona, who last played for France in a January 1995 friendly against the Netherlands, was named by 76 percent of respondents as their first choice in France's ideal team.
Second-placed Patrice Loko was picked by 60 percent while Newcastle's David Ginola, another player ignored by French manager Aime Jacquet, was chosen by 48 percent.
But Cantona was not as successful among people with a real interest of soccer. He was only the fourth choice of the 33 percent of respondents who said they were interested in the sport.
Internazionale's striker Youri Djorkaeff was the experts' number one choice, ahead of Didier Deschamps and Zinedine Zidane.
The poll also underlined France's lack of love for soccer 14 months before the county hosts the World Cup as 67 percent overall, and 84 percent of women, said they had no interest in the game.
